text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا

translations.asad: WHEN THE EARTH quakes with her [last] mighty quaking,
translations.sahih: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake

translations.asad: and [when] the earth yields up her burdens,
translations.sahih: And the earth discharges its burdens

translations.asad: and man cries out, "What has happened to her?" -
translations.sahih: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -

translations.asad: on that Day will she recount all her tidings,
translations.sahih: That Day, it will report its news

translations.asad: as thy Sustainer will have inspired her to do!
translations.sahih: Because your Lord has commanded it.

text.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ

translations.asad: On that Day will all men come forward, cut off from one another, to be shown their [past] deeds.
translations.sahih: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.

text.arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ

translations.asad: And so, he who shall have done an atom's weight of good, shall behold it;
translations.sahih: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,

text.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ

translations.asad: and he who shall have done an atom's weight of evil, shall behold it.
translations.sahih: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
